chapter: The band, its players and singers
title: John Hammond's musical suggestions
summary: Basie says he and Hammond had many meetings over coffee and dinners and Hammond gave wonderful suggestions, but he will not detail them.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Did anybody ever advise you on your music, for example, I know John Hammond was around during those

John and I we had a lot of meetings, I'll call them-- we used to have a lot of coffee, dinners and (inaudible) and we'd talk quite a bit and John had a lot of very wonderful suggestions about certain things. He would say to me to try to do, and he would always just say things about how he saw it and (inaudible) what he felt would sound nice or what happened.
Do you remember any of them.
Well, I remember an awful lot of them but I can't answer you right now.
That's how far you want to go with that.
